source.body:
### Bug Description

On n8n 2.30.7 (self-hosted, Docker, PostgreSQL) the container log is flooded with:

```
TypeError: r.firstEvent.getTime is not a function
    at src/services/workflow-statistics-rollup.service.ts:126:19
    at WorkflowStatisticsRollupService.foldBatch (src/services/workflow-statistics-rollup.service.ts:124:19)
    at WorkflowStatisticsRollupService.rollup (src/services/workflow-statistics-rollup.service.ts:113:18)
```

Rate: ~1,400 occurrences per hour (~34,000 per 24 h), continuously since 2026-09-29. Without log rotation a single container log grew to ~700 MB. Restarting the container does not help — the error reappears within ~3 minutes (1,340 occurrences in the first hour after a restart).

It looks like `firstEvent` comes back from PostgreSQL as a string (not a `Date`) in the rollup batch, so `.getTime()` fails. Possibly related: #28541, #28640 (same pattern with `dbTime.getTime`) and #40019 (rollup refactor).

### To Reproduce

1. Run n8n 2.30.7 in Docker with `DB_TYPE=postgresdb` (PostgreSQL 17).
2. Have ~50 published workflows with ~1,400 executions per day.
3. Watch the container log — the error is emitted continuously by the workflow statistics rollup.

### Expected behavior

Workflow statistics rollup works with PostgreSQL (timestamps parsed as `Date`) and does not flood the log.

### Debug Info

See the stack trace above.

### Operating System

Linux (Docker host)

### n8n Version

2.30.7

### Node.js Version

Bundled with the official image docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:2.30.7

### Database

PostgreSQL

### Execution mode

main (default)

### Hosting

self hosted
